title: Publish a tutoring enquiry page in two weeks
summary: Plan a maths tutoring enquiry page over two weeks, with three hours available each week. Week one covers the offer, copy, and draft page; week two covers form testing, a mobile check, and publication. All six hours are allocated, with no spare time included. This assumes you already have a suitable site-builder account; estimates should be adjusted after the first work session. Start by defining the tutoring offer.
assumptions: You already have a site builder account and can publish without purchasing a new service.
Effort estimates are rough and should be adjusted after the first work session.
Weeks are relative planning blocks because no start date was provided.
limitations: This is a proposed plan; no site, form, or calendar event has been created.

data.goal: Publish one page describing your maths tutoring and accepting enquiries.
success_criteria: The page describes the students you help and the tutoring format.
The enquiry form successfully delivers a test enquiry.
The published page is readable on a phone.

milestones.title: Page ready to test
milestones.done_when: A draft page contains the offer, practical details, and enquiry form.

milestones.title: Page published
milestones.done_when: A test enquiry arrives and the mobile-checked page is published.

tasks.title: Define the tutoring offer
tasks.deliverable: Five bullets covering student level, subjects, lesson format, availability, and enquiry method.

tasks.title: Write the page copy
tasks.deliverable: A headline, short introduction, practical details, and enquiry invitation.

tasks.title: Build the draft page
tasks.deliverable: One draft page in the existing site builder with an enquiry form.

tasks.title: Test the enquiry form
tasks.deliverable: A received test enquiry and corrected form errors.

tasks.title: Check the mobile layout and copy
tasks.deliverable: A readable phone layout with checked contact details and working links.

tasks.title: Publish and verify the live page
tasks.deliverable: A live URL and a successful enquiry submitted through the published page.

data.first_action: Write the five bullets in t1 before opening the site builder.
deferred: Paid advertising, a custom booking system, and additional pages are outside this launch scope.
